role.zh: MiniMax 创始人、董事长兼 CEO

why.en: Former deputy director of SenseTime Research. Differentiated on MoE plus linear attention, and Talkie is among the most successful overseas launches by any Chinese AI product. Took MiniMax public in January 2026.
why.zh: 前商汤研究院副院长。以 MoE 架构与线性注意力路线做出差异化，海外产品 Talkie 是中国 AI 应用出海最成功的案例之一。2026 年 1 月带领 MiniMax 上市。

title.en: Three converging trends could grow token volume 10–100x in 2026
title.zh: 三大趋势交汇，2026 年 token 用量可能增长 10–100 倍

title.en: 对话 MiniMax 闫俊杰：M3、10X 计划、10T 模型、和智能的终局
title.zh: 对话 MiniMax 闫俊杰：M3、10X 计划、10T 模型、和智能的终局

note.en: Recorded live at MiniMax's Dev Meetup, Yan Junjie discussed the M3 model's key breakthroughs, the company's 10X plan, ambitions for a 10T-parameter model, and where he sees intelligence heading.
note.zh: 本期在MiniMax Dev Meetup现场录制，闫俊杰分享了M3模型的关键突破、公司的10X计划、10T参数模型的构想，以及他对智能终局的判断。

title.en: The MiniMax-M2 Series: Mini Activations Unleashing Max Real-World Intelligence
title.zh: The MiniMax-M2 Series: Mini Activations Unleashing Max Real-World Intelligence

note.en: MiniMax's M2 series of Mixture-of-Experts language models, built on the claim that small activated parameter counts can still deliver strong real-world performance.
note.zh: MiniMax 发布的 M2 系列混合专家语言模型，主张以较小的激活参数量实现更强的实际任务表现。

title.en: MiniMax 创始人闫俊杰×罗永浩！大山并非无法翻越
title.zh: MiniMax 创始人闫俊杰×罗永浩！大山并非无法翻越

note.en: In a long-form conversation with Luo Yonghao, Yan Junjie traced his path from a small-county upbringing through Tsinghua and SenseTime to founding MiniMax, saying the mountain ahead is not unclimbable.
note.zh: 在与罗永浩的长篇对谈中，闫俊杰讲述了自己从小县城到清华、再到商汤，最终创立MiniMax的历程，表示前路的高山并非无法翻越。

title.en: MiniMax-M1: Scaling Test-Time Compute Efficiently with Lightning Attention
title.zh: MiniMax-M1: Scaling Test-Time Compute Efficiently with Lightning Attention

note.en: MiniMax's open-weight hybrid-attention reasoning model, which uses lightning attention to scale test-time compute efficiently.
note.zh: MiniMax 开源的混合注意力推理模型，通过 lightning attention 高效扩展测试时计算。

title.en: SynLogic: Synthesizing Verifiable Reasoning Data at Scale for Learning Logical Reasoning and Beyond
title.zh: SynLogic: Synthesizing Verifiable Reasoning Data at Scale for Learning Logical Reasoning and Beyond

note.en: A MiniMax-led method for synthesising verifiable logical-reasoning data at scale, used to train reasoning ability with reinforcement learning.
note.zh: MiniMax 主导的方法，可大规模合成可验证的逻辑推理数据，用于以强化学习训练模型的推理能力。

title.en: One RL to See Them All: Visual Triple Unified Reinforcement Learning
title.zh: One RL to See Them All: Visual Triple Unified Reinforcement Learning

note.en: MiniMax's unified reinforcement learning recipe for post-training vision-language models across visual reasoning and perception tasks at once.
note.zh: MiniMax 提出的统一强化学习方案，可同时在视觉推理与感知任务上对视觉语言模型做后训练。

title.en: MiniMax-Speech: Intrinsic Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech with a Learnable Speaker Encoder
title.zh: MiniMax-Speech: Intrinsic Zero-Shot Text-to-Speech with a Learnable Speaker Encoder

note.en: MiniMax's zero-shot text-to-speech model, whose learnable speaker encoder extracts timbre from a reference clip without needing its transcript.
note.zh: MiniMax 的零样本语音合成模型，其可学习的音色编码器无需参考音频的文本即可提取音色。

title.en: MiniMax 创始人闫俊杰：做大模型，千万别套用移动互联网的逻辑
title.zh: MiniMax 创始人闫俊杰：做大模型，千万别套用移动互联网的逻辑

note.en: Yan Junjie argued that building large models must not follow mobile-internet-era logic — better applications and more users don't necessarily produce better models.
note.zh: 闫俊杰在专访中指出，做大模型千万不能套用移动互联网时代的逻辑——更好的应用和更多用户并不必然带来更好的模型。

title.en: MiniMax-01: Scaling Foundation Models with Lightning Attention
title.zh: MiniMax-01: Scaling Foundation Models with Lightning Attention

note.en: The founding technical report of MiniMax's flagship model series, which put lightning attention into a production-scale foundation model with a very long context window.
note.zh: MiniMax 旗舰模型系列的奠基技术报告，将 lightning attention 用于可支持超长上下文的生产级基础模型。

title.en: Vol.19 对谈 MiniMax 闫俊杰：AI 语音助手的未来是大厂的，还是创业公司的？
title.zh: Vol.19 对谈 MiniMax 闫俊杰：AI 语音助手的未来是大厂的，还是创业公司的？

note.en: Reacting to GPT-4o, Yan Junjie discussed whether the future of AI voice assistants belongs to big tech or startups, and why MiniMax pushed early into general-purpose voice interaction.
note.zh: 在GPT-4o发布后，闫俊杰探讨AI语音助手的未来究竟属于大厂还是创业公司，并谈及MiniMax为何很早就押注通用语音交互。

title.en: Vol.30｜对话 MiniMax 闫俊杰：「Her」已诞生，下一代 AI 助手长啥样？
title.zh: Vol.30｜对话 MiniMax 闫俊杰：「Her」已诞生，下一代 AI 助手长啥样？

note.en: Yan Junjie discussed what the next generation of AI assistants will look like after GPT-4o, saying the 'Her'-style assistant depicted in fiction has effectively already arrived.
note.zh: 闫俊杰在专访中探讨了GPT-4o之后下一代AI助手的样貌，认为电影《her》中描绘的AI助手已基本成为现实。

title.en: cosFormer: Rethinking Softmax in Attention
title.zh: cosFormer: Rethinking Softmax in Attention

note.en: cosFormer proposes a linear-complexity replacement for softmax attention — the research line behind MiniMax's later linear-attention models.
note.zh: cosFormer 论文提出可替代 softmax 注意力的线性复杂度方案，是 MiniMax 日后线性注意力路线的技术源头。

title.en: One to Transfer All: A Universal Transfer Framework for Vision Foundation Model with Few Data
title.zh: One to Transfer All: A Universal Transfer Framework for Vision Foundation Model with Few Data

note.en: A transfer framework that adapts a single vision foundation model to thousands of downstream tasks with very little data, from his years running research at SenseTime.
note.zh: 一套迁移框架，用极少数据将单个视觉基础模型迁移到数千个下游任务，出自他在商汤研究院任职期间的工作。

title.en: INTERN: A New Learning Paradigm Towards General Vision
title.zh: INTERN: A New Learning Paradigm Towards General Vision

note.en: SenseTime and Shanghai AI Lab's learning paradigm for general vision, from his years running research at SenseTime.
note.zh: 商汤与上海人工智能实验室提出的通用视觉学习范式，出自他在商汤研究院任职期间的工作。

title.en: MQBench: Towards Reproducible and Deployable Model Quantization Benchmark
title.zh: MQBench: Towards Reproducible and Deployable Model Quantization Benchmark

note.en: A reproducible benchmark for model quantization that measures algorithms under real deployment conditions, from his SenseTime research years.
note.zh: 面向模型量化的可复现基准，在真实部署条件下评估量化算法，出自其商汤研究院时期的工作。

title.en: Supervision Exists Everywhere: A Data Efficient Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training Paradigm
title.zh: Supervision Exists Everywhere: A Data Efficient Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training Paradigm

note.en: A data-efficient contrastive language-image pre-training method that matches CLIP using far less training data, from his SenseTime research years.
note.zh: 一种数据高效的图文对比预训练方法，用远少于 CLIP 的数据达到相当效果，出自其商汤研究院时期的工作。

title.en: BN-NAS: Neural Architecture Search with Batch Normalization
title.zh: BN-NAS: Neural Architecture Search with Batch Normalization

note.en: Uses batch-normalization statistics alone to score candidate architectures, cutting the cost of neural architecture search, from his SenseTime research years.
note.zh: 仅用批归一化统计量为候选架构打分，从而降低神经架构搜索的开销，出自其商汤研究院时期的工作。

title.en: PSViT: Better Vision Transformer via Token Pooling and Attention Sharing
title.zh: PSViT: Better Vision Transformer via Token Pooling and Attention Sharing

note.en: Cuts two kinds of redundancy in vision transformers through token pooling and attention sharing, from his SenseTime research years.
note.zh: 通过 token 池化与注意力共享减少视觉 Transformer 中的两类冗余，出自其商汤研究院时期的工作。

title.en: MiniMax lists in Hong Kong; shares soar 109% on debut
title.zh: MiniMax 港股上市，首日大涨 109%

body.en: Raised HK$4.8B (~$618M) with a market cap above HK$100B (~$12.8B). Yan's personal fortune later more than doubled to $7.8B.
body.zh: 募资 48 亿港元（约 6.18 亿美元），市值超 1000 亿港元（约 128 亿美元）。闫俊杰个人身家此后翻倍至 78 亿美元。

title.en: M2.5 shipped; three model upgrades in 108 days
title.zh: M2.5 发布；108 天内完成三次模型迭代

body.en: M2 → M2.1 → M2.5. ARR passed $150M in February.
body.zh: M2 → M2.1 → M2.5。2 月 ARR 突破 1.5 亿美元。

title.zh: MiniMax上半年收入大增283%，闫俊杰：多模态是Coding之外第二战场

body.en: MiniMax's first half of 2026: revenue up 283% to $117M, already more than all of last year, with Yan naming multimodal as the company's second battleground after coding.
body.zh: MiniMax 2026 年上半年收入同比增长 283% 至 1.17 亿美元，已超过去年全年；闫俊杰称多模态是继 Coding 之外的第二战场。

title.en: 闫俊杰的「零薪酬」赌局：押上一切冲向AGI
title.zh: 闫俊杰的「零薪酬」赌局：押上一切冲向AGI

body.en: Yan Junjie says he will draw no salary until MiniMax reaches AGI, a striking personal wager tied to the company's mission.
body.zh: 闫俊杰表示在MiniMax实现AGI之前不领取任何薪酬，这是一场与公司使命绑定的个人豪赌。

title.zh: MiniMax融资160亿港元，闫俊杰发内部信：实现AGI前不再领薪

title.en: 和闫俊杰一起敲钟的她：31岁，身价48亿
title.zh: 和闫俊杰一起敲钟的她：31岁，身价48亿

body.en: Coverage of MiniMax's January 2026 IPO bell-ringing ceremony, marking the company Yan Junjie founded going public.
body.zh: 报道了MiniMax于2026年1月上市敲钟仪式，标志着闫俊杰创办的公司正式上市。
